text_en: King David said to the whole assembly, “My son Solomon, whom alone God has chosen, is young and inexperienced, and the work is great; for the temple will not be for mortals but for the Lord God.
text_cn: 达味王又对全会众说：“我的儿子撒罗满，天主所特选的，尚年轻软弱，而这工程又浩大，因为这殿宇不是为人，而是为上主天主；

text_en: So I have provided for the house of my God, so far as I was able, the gold for the things of gold, the silver for the things of silver, and the bronze for the things of bronze, the iron for the things of iron, and wood for the things of wood, besides great quantities of onyx and stones for setting, antimony, colored stones, all sorts of precious stones, and marble in abundance.
text_cn: 为此，我竭尽力量为我天主的殿宇，预备了金子作金器，银子作银器，铜作铜器，铁作铁器，木作木器，且有红玛瑙、可镶嵌的宝石、孔雀石、斑色石、各种玉石，以及很多大理石。

text_en: Moreover, in addition to all that I have provided for the holy house, I have a treasure of my own of gold and silver, and because of my devotion to the house of my God I give it to the house of my God:
text_cn: 此外，因为我爱我天主的殿宇，除了我为建筑圣殿所准备的以外，我还将我私蓄的金银，献给我天主的殿宇：

text_en: three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, for overlaying the walls of the house,
text_cn: 就是，敖非尔金子三千‘塔冷通’，纯银七千‘塔冷通’，为包殿内的墙壁；

text_en: and for all the work to be done by artisans, gold for the things of gold and silver for the things of silver. Who then will offer willingly, consecrating themselves today to the Lord ? ”
text_cn: 金子用来制造金器，银子用来制造银器，和匠人所应作的一切巧工。今天谁自愿给上主捐献呢？”

text_en: Then the leaders of ancestral houses made their freewill offerings, as did also the leaders of the tribes, the commanders of the thousands and of the hundreds, and the officers over the king’s work.
text_cn: 于是各族长、以色列各支派的首领、千夫长、百夫长以及掌管君王劳役的主管，都自愿捐献。

text_en: They gave for the service of the house of God five thousand talents and ten thousand darics of gold, ten thousand talents of silver, eighteen thousand talents of bronze, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.
text_cn: 为了天主殿宇的用途，他们捐献了五千“塔冷通”金子，一万“达理克”，一万“塔冷通”银子，一万八千“塔冷通”铜和十万“塔冷通”铁。

text_en: Whoever had precious stones gave them to the treasury of the house of the Lord , into the care of Jehiel the Gershonite.
text_cn: 凡有宝石的，都交入上主殿内府库里，由革尔雄人耶希耳保管。

text_en: Then the people rejoiced because these had given willingly, for with single mind they had offered freely to the Lord ; King David also rejoiced greatly.
text_cn: 百姓都因这些人甘愿捐献而高兴，因为他们都甘心情愿向上主捐献；达味君王也非常高兴。

text_en: Then David blessed the Lord in the presence of all the assembly; David said: “Blessed are you, O Lord , the God of our ancestor Israel, forever and ever.
text_cn: 达味遂在全会众面前赞颂上主说：“上主，我们的祖先以色列的天主应受赞美，从永远直到永远！

text_en: Yours, O Lord , are the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty; for all that is in the heavens and on the earth is yours; yours is the kingdom, O Lord , and you are exalted as head above all.
text_cn: 上主！伟大、能力、荣耀、壮丽和威严都归于你，因为上天下地所有的一切都是你的。上主！王权属于你，你应受举扬为万有的元首。

text_en: Riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all. In your hand are power and might; and it is in your hand to make great and to give strength to all.
text_cn: 富贵和光荣由你而来，你是一切的主宰；力量和权能在你手中；人强大，人昌盛，都出于你手。

text_en: And now, our God, we give thanks to you and praise your glorious name.
text_cn: 我们的天主，现在我们称颂你，赞扬你荣耀的名。

text_en: “But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to make this freewill offering? For all things come from you, and of your own have we given you.
text_cn: 我算什么？我的百姓又算什么？竟有能力如此甘愿捐献？其实一切是由你而来，我们只是将由你手中得来的，再奉献给你。

text_en: For we are aliens and transients before you, as were all our ancestors; our days on the earth are like a shadow, and there is no hope.
text_cn: 我们在你面前是外方人，是旅居作客的，一如我们的祖先；我们在世上的时日有如阴影，不能持久。

text_en: O Lord our God, all this abundance that we have provided for building you a house for your holy name comes from your hand and is all your own.
text_cn: 上主，我们的天主！我们为建筑敬拜你圣名的殿宇所预备的这一切财物，都是由你而来，也完全是你的。

text_en: I know, my God, that you search the heart, and take pleasure in uprightness; in the uprightness of my heart I have freely offered all these things, and now I have seen your people, who are present here, offering freely and joyously to you.
text_cn: 我的天主！我知道你考验人心，你喜爱正直，我即以正直的心自愿献上这一切，并且我现在很喜欢看见你在这里的百姓，都自愿向你捐献。

text_en: O Lord , the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, our ancestors, keep forever such purposes and thoughts in the hearts of your people, and direct their hearts toward you.
text_cn: 上主，我们祖先亚巴郎、依撒格、以色列的天主！求你永远使你的人民保存这种心思意愿，令他们的心灵坚定于你。

text_en: Grant to my son Solomon that with single mind he may keep your commandments, your decrees, and your statutes, performing all of them, and that he may build the temple for which I have made provision. ”
text_cn: 求你赐给我儿撒罗满一颗纯全的心，遵守你的诫命、你的法律和你的典章，一一实行，用我所准备的来建筑殿宇。”

text_en: Then David said to the whole assembly, “Bless the Lord your God. ” And all the assembly blessed the Lord , the God of their ancestors, and bowed their heads and prostrated themselves before the Lord and the king.
text_cn: 达味对全会众说：“你们应该赞颂上主，你们的天主！”全会众便赞颂了上主，他们祖先的天主，向上主，及君王俯首下拜。

text_en: On the next day they offered sacrifices and burnt offerings to the Lord , a thousand bulls, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their libations, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel;
text_cn: 次日，他们向上主献了牺牲，向上主献了全燔祭：牛犊一千，公山羊一千，羔羊一千，以及同献的奠祭，并为以色列民众献了许多牺牲。

text_en: and they ate and drank before the Lord on that day with great joy. They made David’s son Solomon king a second time; they anointed him as the Lord ’s prince, and Zadok as priest.
text_cn: 那天，他们在上主面前，欢天喜地地吃喝，以后，他们二次立达味的儿子撒罗满为王，给他傅油，为上主作人君；又给匝多克傅油，立他为大司祭。

text_en: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the Lord , succeeding his father David as king; he prospered, and all Israel obeyed him.
text_cn: 于是撒罗满坐在上主的宝座上，代他父亲达味为王；他非常顺利，全以色列都服从他。

text_en: All the leaders and the mighty warriors, and also all the sons of King David, pledged their allegiance to King Solomon.
text_cn: 所有的首领、勇士以及达味王所有的儿子，都属撒罗满王权下。

text_en: The Lord highly exalted Solomon in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
text_cn: 上主在全以色列民众面前，特别高举了撒罗满，赐予他君王的威严，胜过以前所有的以色列君王。

text_en: Thus David son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
text_cn: 叶瑟的儿子达味统治了全以色列，

text_en: The period that he reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
text_cn: 统治以色列为时凡四十年：在赫贝龙为王七年，在耶路撒冷为王三十三年。

text_en: He died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and his son Solomon succeeded him.
text_cn: 他死时年纪很大，享了高寿和荣华富贵；他的儿子撒罗满继位为王。

text_en: Now the acts of King David, from first to last, are written in the records of the seer Samuel, and in the records of the prophet Nathan, and in the records of the seer Gad,
text_cn: 达味王的前后事迹，都记载在《先见者撒慕尔言行录》、《先知纳堂言行录》和《先见者加得言行录》上。

text_en: with accounts of all his rule and his might and of the events that befell him and Israel and all the kingdoms of the earth.
text_cn: 他与国家有关的大事、他的武功，以及他与以色列和四邻各国所经历的史事，全都记载在这些书上。
